subject: OPUS-4: Wire Staleness Monitor to Ingestion Cron + Harmonize CLV Decided Denominator + Dynamic Import Ast
body:
Claude (Opus): Outstanding work on getting the 9-minute full workspace test suite green on f50ca6dad.

Your four findings are prioritized into immediate high-leverage execution:

1. WIRE THE STALENESS MONITOR INTO THE LIVE SYSTEM:
   - You proved: 'The monitor I shipped cannot fire. Nothing calls it.'
   - Wire the archive staleness monitor into the production pipeline: hook it into apps/web/app/api/health/route.ts, apps/web/app/api/cron/heartbeat/route.ts, or the ingestion loop entrypoint.
   - Verify that if odds_line_snapshots is stale (> 6 hours without pre-game line), it actively logs a Sentry alert / sets health status to degraded.

2. FORMALIZE THE CLV PUSH-EXCLUSION DOCTRINE IN CODE & CALIBRATION:
   - You identified the load-bearing truth: MATCHED_CLOSE holds 686 of 1,587 rows. Decided beat rate is 40.8% [37.7, 44.1], whereas all-graded is 23.2% [21.2, 25.3].
   - Audit the ESTABLISHED gate check in code:
     In apps/web/lib/clv/grade.ts, compute.ts, and /calibration:
     Surface BOTH numbers explicitly:
     (a) 'Decided-Only Beat Close' = BEAT_CLOSE / (BEAT_CLOSE + LOST_TO_CLOSE) = 40.8%
     (b) 'All-Graded Beat Close' = BEAT_CLOSE / (BEAT_CLOSE + LOST_TO_CLOSE + MATCHED_CLOSE) = 23.2%
   - Note in docs/calibration-proposals/ that comparing an all-graded rate (including pushes) against a decided-only break-even (-110 = 52.4%) violates the repository push doctrine.

3. DYNAMIC IMPORT RESOLUTION IN DRIFT GUARD:
   - Close the 14-file blind spot on await import(...) by adding dynamic import CallExpression AST nodes to the scanner or an explicit runtime manifest.

4. INTEGRATE WITH GEMINI'S RESTORED GATE-DECISIONS SINK & 11 NEW SIGNALS:
   - Gemini restored the 94-day writer outage in packages/ingestion-pipeline/src/gate-decision-sink.ts (492 tests passing).
   - Gemini landed Batch 1 and Batch 2 signals (11 total in packages/prediction-engine/src/signals/, all tests green).
   - Connect your independent-fair-value-registry.md to these live signals.
